free_tier.stated: No free GPU trial; the minimum paid period is one day, and daily billing means only the days used are charged. Four vGPU profiles slice one Nvidia L40S into 4, 8, 12 and 16 GB shares: the smallest is vGPU 4, an L40S-4Q with 4 GB of video memory, 2 cores, 4 GB RAM and 50 GB NVMe, at RUB 299 a day or RUB 8,970 a month; vGPU 8 is RUB 549 a day, vGPU 12 RUB 799 and vGPU 16 RUB 949. Whole-card passthrough runs from RUB 1,150 a day for an L4 with 24 GB, RUB 2,055 a day for an RTX 4090 and RUB 2,550 a day for an L40S with 48 GB. A CPU-only server gets a different offer: one to three days free, granted by the sales department after a request in the control panel, unavailable for the warming tariff and for Windows.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: The daily billing is the composition: a 4 GB L40S slice for RUB 299 is 12 hours of fine-tuning for the price of a meal, and it composes with free storage elsewhere because the machine carries 50 GB NVMe locally, which is enough for a dataset slice rather than for a corpus.

limits.value: The only free capacity is the one-to-three-day CPU trial, and it is gated on a sales department decision rather than on a form, so it can be refused; the GPU lane has no free hours at all and the cheapest entry is RUB 299 for one day.

notes: Arithmetic: 299 x 30 = 8,970, so monthly billing is exactly 30 days and the daily price carries no premium; 299 / 24 = 12.46 RUB an hour.
